lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in roughly vertical columns along the mid-lateral flank, posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting with the primary circular blobs to create a grid-like pattern of anchor nodes across the central flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features extending along the upper flank, characterized by a high-intensity luminance gradient on the dorsal edge and shadowed low-intensity pixels on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Moderate distribution of high-luminance blobs visible within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin located in the upper right background quadrant.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent V-shaped indentation or loss of tissue on the posterior trailing edge of the visible pectoral fin.
